When the roller icon is shown at the lower left of the screen, you move by Roller Dash. Press #B to turn the roller icon ON/OFF.
When the roller icon is not shown at the lower left, you move on foot. Try pressing #B to turn the icon OFF.
Press in the left stick to pick up a weapon on the ground. The weapon you were holding will be dropped in its place.
Shooting or melee attacks will sometimes score a Critical that damages the enemy AT's pilot.||Criticals happen more often when you attack on foot, and you can board an AT whose pilot's HP has hit 0.
Treasure is hidden inside containers and the like. You can't collect it while riding an AT. Breakable containers are a bit darker, so smash them when you find them!
When the Mission Disk (MD) gauge at the lower left is full, hold L2 and approach an enemy. When the double-lock icon appears, press #D or #B to activate a Combat Program.
Hold L2 and press #E to activate an Action Program. These reproduce special AT maneuvers. Try them in all sorts of situations.
Press #C from behind an enemy to knock them out instantly. Use it a lot and something good might happen.
If your AT is destroyed, press SELECT to bail out. If you fail, it's game over. (In this mission, you bail out automatically.)
Press L1 or R1 near an enemy to lock on. While locked on, press L1 or R1 again to cycle through targets.||Note: you can't lock on to enemy soldiers while riding an AT.
Press L1 and R1 together to release the lock at any time. When you want to focus on moving, release it and move freely!
*Controls shown are for controller Type A.
